integrity: All claimed identities proved analytically, with exact-rational and symbolic replay; finite verification supplements, not replaces, the general proof. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a five-site reflected path with two positive conductance levels and mass matrix I; end-step entrywise nonnegativity, not stage positivity. Older equivalent weighted-Neumann tridiagonal theorems cannot be entirely excluded.
title: A sharp active-site switch for Crank–Nicolson positivity on a mirrored weighted path
